description: This is an abstract class definition for parsing error responses in the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides a template for subclasses to implement specific payload parsing logic and includes methods for extracting and populating error data from responses.

classes.name: AbstractErrorParser
classes.description: An abstract class that provides basic error response parsing infrastructure for AWS SDK PHP. It uses traits for metadata and payload parsing, and defines abstract and concrete methods for extracting payloads and populating error shape data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an optional Service object to associate with this error parser.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Abstract method for parsing the payload from a response, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload from the response, either via the payload method if the member is a StructureShape or by returning the response body stream.

methods.name: populateShape
methods.description: Populates error data shape with information from the response, optionally matching known error shapes based on the command name and code.
